description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3040994796767 CYLINDER ASSEMBLY,A: Line 0001 Qty 23 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0088 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
